label: Import Filter (Sync Gateway)
type: a user-authored JavaScript predicate function, scoped per collection, deciding whether Sync Gateway imports a given Couchbase-Server-side document mutation. Defaults to importing all documents when unset. Sibling of sgw:custom-conflict-resolver and sgw:webhook-filter under the shared sgw:sync-function umbrella - all four are provisioned the same way (Admin REST API) and share the same JS-function-body shape.
note: configuration-schema-import-filter.md documents this mechanism in full (provisioning, schema, worked example); its access-control sibling page (configuration-schema-access-control.md, same batch) is a near-empty stub for the analogous sync-function/access-control mechanism - see docs-issues.
